name: Tumerok Outpost (9.0N, 65.7W)
title: 9.0N, 65.7W - Tumerok Outpost
summary: A small Tumerok outpost over the Tumerok Base dungeon on a ledge (z 128) below a high ridge in the Dires near Fort Tethana. It has a 31 m spire tower, flat-roofed halls with stake palisades and a tapered-roof brick bunker (0x0100110A, 17 interior cells). As acpedia says, a trail of candle-bearing Empyrean statues (Master's Sentinel, 3 m) leads north from the bunker.

shots.standingOrder: Hold level with the head of the candle-bearing Empyrean sentinel 10 m away on the trail, sharp in the lower left, then pull focus 76 m to the spire tower of the bunker; drift under 1 m.
shots.notes: Rack focus on the statue trail: acpedia says Empyrean statues mark a trail to the bunker. The lens sits level with the head of the northern candle-bearing Master's Sentinel, 10 m from it. The statue's head is sharp in the lower left (ndc -0.4, -0.5) and the 31 m spire tower of the outpost is centred 76 m away. At 45% of the take, focus pulls over 1.6 s from the statue to the tower. The fov is widened to 55 so the statue stays in frame. The SW sun is ahead-right, so the statue and tower are rim-lit.
